summary: Request restricted access to billing ledger table for Finance/RevOps reconciliation (audit-logged, time-bounded)
description:
Requesting restricted, audit-logged access to the billing ledger dataset/table(s) used as RevRec source-of-truth for invoice generation.

Background:
Finance/RevRec and RevOps are doing a meter audit + reconciliation effort for Hosted API usage and Dedicated usage. We need to run ad-hoc queries that tie together: (a) usage events exports, (b) customer-facing usage API exports, and (c) billing ledger line items / daily aggregation used for invoices.

Business justification:
- Reconcile invoice discrepancies and classify causes (late-arriving events, retries/dedupe issues, missing dimensions).
- Validate metering fixes in shadow-billing compare mode without changing invoices.
- Support month-end close usage freeze and RevRec audit readiness.

Requested access (least privilege):
- Warehouse: Snowflake (prod)
- Datasets/tables: "billing_ledger" / "invoice_usage_ledger" (exact table name TBD by Data Platform; may be behind a secure view)
- Access type: read-only via a SECURITYADMIN-approved role; time-bounded 60 days; all queries audit-logged.
- Requesters:
  1) Rishi Malhotra (FP&A) – margin model / pricing analysis
  2) Chris Osei (Product Ops) – pricing experiment analysis and reconciliation
  3) Emily Stone (RevRec/Accounting) – month-end close and invoice preview

Constraints/requirements:
- Must comply with metering data retention & access controls policy.
- Access must be limited to finance-approved individuals; do not grant broad org access.
- Audit logging required: who queried, when, and what objects accessed.
- Prefer a curated secure view that excludes customer PII where possible (account_id OK; avoid raw emails/addresses unless strictly necessary).

Deliverables:
- Create/read-only role + secure view(s) for billing ledger with documented schema.
- Configure warehouse/object access + row-level policies if applicable.
- Confirm audit logging is enabled and where logs can be retrieved (for audit evidence).
- Post the final table/view names and example query patterns in this ticket.

Requested by:
Emily Stone (RevRec) on behalf of Finance/RevOps meter reconciliation initiative.

Target date:
Need access before 2026-02-14 to support discrepancy sampling and month-end close run-through.
acceptance_criteria: Provision a time-bounded, read-only Snowflake role granting access only to the minimum billing ledger views needed for reconciliation
Audit logging is enabled and validated (sample audit event captured and retrievable)
Schema / view definitions are documented in the ticket and linked to the reconciliation playbook
Access request is approved by Finance owner and Security/Data owner; approval evidence captured in ticket comments
security_notes: Data classification: Restricted (billing/financial records). Access must be least-privilege, time-bounded, and audit-logged. Do not export raw ledger data to unsecured locations. Use Snowflake secure views where possible.
